title.narrative: Programa de Educacin Secundaria
Secondary Education Program

description.narrative: THE GOAL OF THE PROGRAM IS TO ENSURE THAT CHILDREN FROM ALL BACKGROUNDS ARE PREPARED TO PARTICIPATE IN AN CONTRIBUTE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF CIVIL SOCIETY. SPECIFIC OBJETIVES INCLUDE: TARGETED EQUITY AND QUALITY IMPROVEMENT IN SECONDARY EDUCATION; INCREASED ACCESS TO GENERAL SECONDARY EDUCATION; RATIONALIZATION OF THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION'S ROLE IN THE GOVERNANCE AND PROVISION OF TECHNIVALVOCATIONAL TRAINING; AND IDENTIFICATION OF OPTIONS FORM IMPROVED SECTOR PERFORMANCE.
